image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is translucent grey plastic with visible internal components including two spools and the central hub mechanism. There are handwritten labels on the top and bottom sticker areas with illegible or garbled text. The image has a grainy, low-resolution aesthetic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the labels is nonsensical and malformed, resembling AI-generated hallucinations rather than real handwriting or print. Characters merge and lack linguistic structure.

The image has an unnatural, uniform noise/grain pattern that looks more like digital generation artifacts than optical film grain or sensor noise. The plastic texture lacks realistic specular highlights.
The edges of the central tape window appear slightly soft and irregular, lacking the sharp, molded precision expected of mass-produced plastic.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. If the text is confirmed as gibberish, this is a strong signal of AI generation. Also, verify if the 'noise' in the image is consistent with real ISO grain or if it shows signs of generative smoothing/artifacts.
